status: Committed fix passes canonical RPM builds and installed runtime/SDK checks on all three x86_64 distributions, plus unsigned-char Debug/Valgrind controls. Native ARM rebuilds and signed installed checks remain pending. Verified OBS revision 2 uploaded with publication disabled.
root_cause: Three YAML URI helper functions return plain char but use SCN_FAIL=-1. On ARM unsigned char converts failure to 255: callers miss the failure case, and malformed escapes can loop without advancing.
fix: Use the same signed ScanResult enum for all three results, retaining -1/0/1 values. Immutable upstream input and fixed output hashes remain checked. No global character-signedness flag or warning suppression.
regression_scope: Compile all fixed Python/YAML translation units under signed and unsigned char with warnings as errors; exercise 27 URI status/callback cases per mode including empty input, delimiters, truncated/bad hex and valid escapes. Qore malformed-tag cases verify parser recovery.

command:

dnf -y --setopt=install_weak_deps=False install valgrind

test "$(command -v qore)" = /usr/bin/qore
"$@"
cmake --build build-debug --parallel 4
cmake --build build-debug --target docs --parallel 2
python3 -B -W error test/test_grammar_fixes.py tree-sitter-python-0.25.0 tree-sitter-yaml-0.7.2 -v
export QORE_PCRE2_NO_JIT=1 QORE_TREESITTER_QUERY_DIR=/source/build-debug/queries
setpriv --reuid=1019 --regid=100 --clear-groups -- /usr/bin/qore -b --enable-debug -l /source/build-debug/treesitter-api-2.0.qmod test/treesitter.qtest -v
